record.field: # Run as a chunked background import (one page per job) for every connected # store that has customer sync enabled — non-blocking and scalable. instances = env['shopify.instance'].search([('state', '=', 'connected'), ('sync_customers', '=', True)]) for inst in instances: env['shopify.queue'].enqueue_historical_import(inst, 'customers', {'chunked': True}) msg = ('Customer import started in the background for %d store(s). ' 'Track progress in Monitoring → Sync Queue.') % len(instances) if instances \ else 'No connected stores with customer sync enabled.' action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'Import Customers', 'message': msg, 'type': 'success' if instances else 'warning', }, }

if len(records) != 2: raise UserError("Select exactly two customers to merge (the first is kept).") keeper, dup = records[0], records[1] dup.merge_into_on_shopify(keeper) action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': {'title': 'Customers Merged', 'message': 'Merged into %s on Shopify.' % keeper.display_name, 'type': 'success'}, }

field.name: help
field.p: These run syncing automatically on a timer. Open one to change its frequency or use Run Manually to trigger it now.
